name: Animals In Captivity
overview: Scripture reveals that animals in captivity are to be cared for with intentionality and compassion, as seen in God's instructions to preserve clean and unclean beasts during the flood (Genesis 7:2). The righteous person is characterized by a regard for the life of their animals, contrasting with the cruelty of the wicked (Proverbs 12:10). Furthermore, diligent oversight of flocks and herds is commanded, emphasizing responsible stewardship and heartfelt attention to their condition (Proverbs 27:23).
